style: Abstract black and white motion graphics, monochrome, white and silver light on pure black, no color. The clip starts on a completely black frame and the action builds steadily to a striking climax in the last seconds. One continuous shot, smooth motion, crisp detail, high contrast, cinematic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people.

themes.name: Ignition network
themes.prompt: From pure black, a single tiny point of white light appears in the center. It pulses, then splits and branches outward faster and faster into thousands of fine glowing white filaments that connect into a vast three-dimensional network filling the whole frame. The camera slowly pulls back.

themes.name: Scan
themes.prompt: From pure black, a vast flat grid of millions of tiny dim white dots stretches to the horizon. A bright vertical wall of white light sweeps quickly across the grid from left to right; every dot it touches flashes and then fades, and only a handful of dots stay blazing white after it passes. Low camera angle, the camera tracks along with the sweep.

themes.name: Lattice
themes.prompt: From pure black, thousands of small white particles rush in from every direction and snap together into a precise hexagonal lattice of rings and bonds, like an endless molecular crystal. Once it locks into place, a wave of light ripples across the whole structure. The camera slowly rotates around it.

themes.name: Warp
themes.prompt: From pure black, faint white points appear, then stretch into streaks as the camera accelerates forward through them, faster and faster, until the streaks form a brilliant tunnel of light rushing past. At the end everything converges into a single bright point.

themes.name: Bloom
themes.prompt: From pure black, a single drop of liquid silver falls in slow motion into a still black liquid surface. It creates a sharp crown splash, then perfect concentric rings of light spread outward across the whole surface. Macro, slow motion.
